blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water is urging customers to prepare wisely for the possible effects of a strong to very strong El Niño by preventing water waste, reporting leaks promptly, and avoiding unnecessary water storage while supply remains normal. The weather phenomenon is expected to increase the likelihood of below-normal rainfall, dry spells, and drought in parts of the country. Its effects, however, may vary by location and may not immediately result in water service interruptions. “Responsible preparation is not about reacting out of fear or storing more water than a household needs.
